pull_request.body:
…up lints

Closes #59, 
Closes #60, 
Closes #61, 
Closes #62

Each section adds a bad_/good_/allowed_ triplet of fixture functions that documents the structural pattern the (not-yet-implemented) lint is expected to catch.

  - excessive_vec_capacity       (issue #59) — Vec::with_capacity on a wildly
    larger capacity than needed
  - expensive_crypto_in_loop     (issue #60) — env.crypto() calls inside a
    loop (loop-bound input so existing unnecessary_host_function_call does
    not also fire and skew main.stderr)
  - redundant_storage_read       (issue #61) — repeated storage::get of the
    same key inside a function (kept outside any loop so the existing
    soroban_storage_in_loop does not also fire)
  - unnecessary_vec_allocation   (issue #62) — empty / unused Vec::new()
    allocations

The mock soroban_sdk::Vec in this UI test now also exposes new() and with_capacity() so the capacity fixture has something concrete to call.

A crate-inner-attribute #![allow(unknown_lints)] sits at the top so rustc does not emit unknown_lints warnings for the seven #[allow(<future_lint>)] markers — those markers are forward-compatible: no-op until each lint is registered in src/lib.rs, at which point they become real suppressions without any further edit.

main.stderr remains unchanged because the four lints are not yet wired into the lint pass; the fixtures are a behavioural specification for when they are.

    same key inside a function (kept outside any loop so the existing
    soroban_storage_in_loop does not also fire)
  - unnecessary_vec_allocation   (issue #62) — empty / unused Vec::new()

The mock soroban_sdk::Vec in this UI test now also exposes new() and
with_capacity() so the capacity fixture has something concrete to call.

A crate-inner-attribute #![allow(unknown_lints)] sits at the top so rustc
does not emit unknown_lints warnings for the seven #[allow(<future_lint>)]
markers — those markers are forward-compatible: no-op until each lint is

main.stderr remains unchanged because the four lints are not yet wired
into the lint pass; the fixtures are a behavioural specification for when
they are.
fix type errors and clippy warnings
fix storage_iter_closure contract: import soroban_sdk vec macro and Vec type
fix soroban_sdk vec! macro usage: requires &env as first argument
fix cli_integration_workspace: remove workspace roots from child contracts
update ui test stderr line numbers (+12 shift)
